method: Human-visible image inspection using the image viewer after native rendering. Hashes pin the reviewed images.
observations: The assembled case and all front controls are preserved.
Rear view and closeup show eleven entrances; no obsolete display disks cover the sockets.
All four DINs use horizontal outer contact centers and retain their three lower contacts.
MIDI OUT, THRU, MIDI IN and SYNC legends are readable at the retained panel positions.
Exploded view retains both boards, original case/panels and PCB-mounted controls.
Control-side and wiring-study views retain their intentional cap visibility and illustrative wiring.
limitations: The DIN interior remains dark with retained materials; image inspection supplements geometric ray checks.
Rear panel shadows and remaining nominal seating intersections remain as documented.
Images do not qualify physical assembly fit.
